_note: 2_01 'Last Minute Shopping' — Edna's errand: fetch her bike and collect three shopping items (grocery / barber / clothing) from the Vale business district, then get back to her in the cafeteria before dinner prep dies of old age (recon: docs/re-notes/ch2/2_01-last-minute-shopping.md). v1 simplifications (see the recon's gap table): the baked 2-01 cutscene is a title card + speech beat; the bike is a reach beat, not a spawned vehicle (no vehicle bundle yet — the original also completes the beat on simply reaching the business district); the three stores collect in a fixed order (the original is free-order with a 0/3 HUD counter — collect_counter pending, the objective line carries it); the store pickups are reach+give_item beats (the originals spawn lazily per interior entry; the four in-engine store cutscenes are dead code in the original — never wired); the bus ride back is compressed to walking (no bus/gBusTransition system); the grocery clerk bark is a plain text beat (the clerk belongs to the ambient store system, not the mission); the 325 s fail timer is our visible mission countdown (re-armed per stage with resume; full reset on retry); the hit-Edna fail is compressed to a KO; the janitor/attic door unlocks, gEdnaOverride/unique-model suppression and the interactive music tiers are skipped (no ambient Edna / music-tier systems); Edna's persist-into-ambient handoff is skipped (she despawns on pass like every mission npc). Pass grants 5 egg ammo (312) via the campaign on_pass (the original tops up only if the player holds zero; ours tops up to 5). Wording is original; ped_model_id records the original model ids next to the stand-in meshes.
title: Last Minute Shopping

lines.speaker: EDNA
lines.text: Jimmy! Dinner's doomed unless someone fetches my bike and does my shopping. Three stops, downtown. And be quick about it!

on_start.text: Her bike is parked by the school gates.

stages.objective: Stop one of three: the grocery store.

on_complete.speaker: CLERK
on_complete.text: Edna's order, all wrapped. Tell her the roast better not burn this time.

stages.objective: Stop two of three: the barber shop.
Stop three of three: the clothing store.
Get the shopping back to Edna in the cafeteria.

on_complete.speaker: EDNA
on_complete.text: Dinner is saved! You're a good boy, Jimmy. Here — for your trouble.
campaign on_pass for 2_01 tops up egg ammo (312) to 5; bus-return and bike-mount beats compressed (no transit/vehicle systems yet)
